pull_request.title: Infrastructure: preserve calorimeter campaign history and token accounting
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-campaign-record
pull_request.body:
Preserves the audit trail while ECAL #70/#71/#73/#74/#75 move into the single main-targeted replacement #115. The campaign table retains every original source head, task identity, shared-account relationship, label and unresolved #75 human review. HCAL #81/#84/#85 are refreshed separately; FCAL #88 is already merged.

Recovered54 previously uncounted finalized turns into17 existing canonical session owners: **258,511,843 input +1,432,322 output =259,944,165 observed tokens**. Repeated snapshots, already-counted turns, mixed-task allocations and active campaign turns are excluded. Shared turns have one owner and multiple PR references. Existing FCAL recommendation accounting is linked rather than duplicated.

The recovery reader now streams existing compressed .jsonl.zst archives when the client database retains the original .jsonl path. It never retains raw transcripts/private state and installs no dependency. Thirteen original paired journals are retained from immutable branch revisions; individual interaction ledgers are refreshed and synchronized.

Validation:36 logging tests;14 recovery controls also pass on Python3.11 with the existing zstd executable;247 paired journals,101 interaction ledgers and432 dated token turns validate; token-site build passes. This PR changes infrastructure/accounting only and is excluded from scientific progress. Detector geometry and validation remain in #115 and the subsystem PRs.

Merge this main-targeted infrastructure record before #115. Once replacement provenance is published, close the five superseded PRs with reciprocal links and additive campaign/supersession labels. No branch deletion, history rewriting or review approval is implied. The active root turn remains uncounted until a later finalized capture.

Full mapping, exact owner subtotals, import/replay evidence and limitations: `logs/usage/CAMPAIGN-2026-11-04-calorimeters.md` and its adjacent usage-only inventory.

Explicit fallback SoftEng assignment `CAL114-Accounting`, from the campaign
coordinator, source main `cd3ec20da56537617ac6fbbcf28bd6f28104cc64`.
The worktree `codex/calorimeter-campaign-record` began clean. The paired journal
was created after this assignment's own recovery-tool edits, so its captured
`initial_changes` accurately lists those edits; no unrelated edits existed.
Read the full prepared mandate and relevant repository/logging/interaction
instructions. No delegation, remote mutation, scientific source edits, package
installation or human sign-off was performed.

The user asks to preserve work, tokens, interactions and PR identities when
consolidating ECAL70/71/73/74/75 with issue114, and to prepare HCAL/FCAL PRs.
The coordinator's initial historical recovery failed because the client had
compressed archived `.jsonl` paths into `.jsonl.zst` without updating the stored
plain paths. This assignment fixes that infrastructure boundary and recovers
only allowlisted usage evidence.

events.text: Compressed archival usage recovery for the calorimeter consolidation campaign — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

Committed `8845463d7a5f420447be1c850a4f99c6e1bc850f` on `codex/calorimeter-campaign-record`; working tree clean.

- Imported 54 historical turns once: **258,511,843 input + 1,432,322 output = 259,944,165 tokens**.
- Restored 13 original journal pairs and synchronized 17 affected PR ledgers.
- Passed 36 logging tests, 14 Python 3.11 recovery tests, journal/interaction validation, and token-site build.
- No scientific files or remote state changed.

Current completed-child accounting is in `/tmp/nodd-cal114-current-children.json`: **24,575,707 tokens across five finalized turns**, with exact parent edges and proposed owners. Those entries remain unimported; active root/accounting turns are excluded.

coverage.unknowns: Unrecorded names, models, tools, subagent identities and response links remain unknown; empty lists are not zero activity.
